purpose: Source/task parity and existing candidate correction checkpoint under original V1 A-D; not academic approval
title: Write Times

originalTasks: Count around analog clock from 12 to half-turn and circle 6 at minute 30
READ and WRITE times for each complete clock
DRAW the missing MINUTE hand on incomplete clocks and write the time
Given ONLY a minute hand, draw one possible HOUR hand, write resulting time and propose alternative valid hours
stageA.identifiedGap: Existing learner instructions covered reading/half-hour minutes but omitted drawing a missing minute hand and open-choice hour hand; digital clock-value grading cannot substitute for original drawing.

stageB.sourceBoundary: Only first-party text; real pupil clock-face diagrams remain teacher-reviewed; no publisher picture copied

stageC.digitalPartialSkill: Recognize hour/half-hour and write numerical time
stageC.originalSourceAuthoredTask: Open-choice drawing with multiple possible valid hours cannot be proven by one auto-scored time answer
